situations.title: 수혈 전 확인·동의
situations.tagline: Let's double-check this unit against his ID and blood type together.
situations.brief: 이중확인과 혈액형 대조로 수혈 전 확인과 동의를 완료하세요.
keyPhrases: Two of us will verify the patient ID and unit at the bedside.
Blood type, unit number, and expiration all match.
Consent is signed and in the chart.

situations.title: 수혈 시작·초기 감시
situations.tagline: Start it slow for the first fifteen minutes and stay at the bedside with me.
situations.brief: 초반 활력징후를 감시하며 수혈을 천천히 시작하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll run it slow for the first fifteen minutes.
Baseline vitals are recorded before we start.
I'll stay at the bedside and reassess vitals shortly.

situations.title: 수혈 반응 징후 인지
situations.tagline: He says he feels flushed and short of breath — is this a reaction?
situations.brief: 발열과 발진, 호흡곤란 등 수혈 반응 징후를 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: Fever, rash, or dyspnea can signal a transfusion reaction.
I'm stopping the transfusion and keeping the line open with saline.
I'll take a full set of vitals and notify the provider.

situations.title: 혈액 성분 종류 이해
situations.tagline: Remind me — what does each component actually replace for this patient?
situations.brief: RBC와 FFP, 혈소판 등 혈액 성분의 종류와 목적을 이해하세요.
keyPhrases: Packed red cells raise oxygen-carrying capacity.
FFP replaces clotting factors, platelets treat thrombocytopenia.
Cryoprecipitate is for low fibrinogen.

situations.title: 혈액 취급·보관
situations.tagline: This unit's been out a while — do we still have time to start it?
situations.brief: 온도와 시간 규정을 지켜 혈액을 취급하고 보관하세요.
keyPhrases: Blood must be started within thirty minutes of leaving the fridge.
It has to be infused within four hours of hanging.
If we can't start it, I'll send it back to the blood bank.

situations.title: 수혈 중 활력 주기 기록
situations.tagline: Keep the monitor on him and log vitals on the transfusion schedule.
situations.brief: 모니터를 유지하며 수혈 중 활력징후를 주기적으로 기록하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll record vitals at fifteen minutes, then hourly.
Temperature is stable and there's no new tachycardia.
The monitor is on and alarms are set.

situations.title: 급성 용혈반응 초기 대응
situations.tagline: He's got back pain, chills, and dark urine — stop that blood right now!
situations.brief: 즉시 중단하고 급성 용혈반응에 초기 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm stopping the transfusion and disconnecting the tubing.
I'll keep the line open with normal saline.
Send the unit and a blood sample back for a reaction workup.

situations.title: TACO와 TRALI 감별
situations.tagline: She's desaturating an hour into the unit — is this TACO or TRALI?
situations.brief: 수혈 관련 호흡곤란에서 TACO와 TRALI를 감별하세요.
keyPhrases: TACO points to volume overload with hypertension.
TRALI is non-cardiogenic with normal filling pressures.
Either way, I'm stopping the transfusion and supporting oxygenation.

situations.title: 대량수혈 비율 관리
situations.tagline: We're running the massive transfusion protocol — keep the ratio at one-to-one-to-one.
situations.brief: 1:1:1 비율을 유지하며 대량수혈을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm giving plasma, platelets, and red cells at a one-to-one-to-one ratio.
I'll track each unit and warm the products.
Next cooler is on the way from the blood bank.

situations.title: 응고검사 해석·성분 선택
situations.tagline: His INR is up and fibrinogen is low — which products should we give?
situations.brief: INR과 fibrinogen을 해석해 적절한 혈액 성분을 선택하세요.
keyPhrases: The elevated INR calls for plasma or PCC.
Low fibrinogen means we should give cryoprecipitate.
I'll recheck coags after correction.

situations.title: 저칼슘·시트르산 독성 감시
situations.tagline: After all these units, watch his calcium — citrate can drop it fast.
situations.brief: 대량수혈에 따른 저칼슘과 시트르산 독성을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Citrate binds calcium, so I'll monitor ionized calcium.
Watch for perioral tingling and a prolonged QT.
I'll have calcium ready to replace per protocol.

situations.title: 항응고 역전 관리
situations.tagline: He's bleeding on warfarin — let's reverse him with PCC and vitamin K.
situations.brief: PCC와 vitamin K로 항응고를 역전하고 출혈을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll give four-factor PCC and IV vitamin K now.
I'll recheck the INR after reversal.
For his DOAC, we may need the specific reversal agent.

situations.title: 혈소판 수혈 적응 판단
situations.tagline: His platelets are low but he's not bleeding — do we transfuse or wait?
situations.brief: 역치를 기준으로 혈소판 수혈 적응 여부를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: The prophylactic threshold is usually ten thousand.
Before a procedure, we aim for a higher count.
Active bleeding changes the threshold entirely.

situations.title: 알레르기·발열 반응 관리
situations.tagline: She got hives with the last unit — should we premedicate this time?
situations.brief: 전처치로 알레르기와 발열 반응을 예방하고 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: For mild hives, I'll pause and give an antihistamine.
We can premedicate before the next unit.
If she develops wheezing, I'll stop and escalate.

situations.title: 수혈 거부 환자 관리
situations.tagline: I need you to know — my faith means I can't accept any blood products.
situations.brief: 대안과 소통으로 수혈을 거부하는 환자를 존중하며 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: I respect your decision and I'll document your wishes.
Let's talk about blood-conservation options with your team.
We can maximize iron and minimize blood draws.

situations.title: 대량수혈 프로토콜 발동·조율
situations.tagline: Activate the MTP — I need the team, the cooler, and roles assigned now!
situations.brief: MTP 팀을 발동하고 대량수혈 프로토콜을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm activating the massive transfusion protocol now.
You track products, you push blood, I'll run the rapid infuser.
Blood bank, send the next cooler and keep them coming.

situations.title: 급성 용혈 아나필락시스 위기
situations.tagline: She's hypotensive with stridor right after the unit — this is anaphylaxis, get epi!
situations.brief: 급성 용혈과 아나필락시스를 소생술로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop the transfusion — I'm giving IM epinephrine now.
I'm opening fluids wide and calling the code team.
Airway is compromised, prepare to intubate.

situations.title: DIC 출혈·혈전 동반 위기
situations.tagline: He's oozing from every site and his labs scream DIC — we have to treat the cause!
situations.brief: 성분 보충과 원인 치료로 DIC의 출혈과 혈전을 동시에 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: He's bleeding from every puncture site — this is DIC.
I'll replace fibrinogen, platelets, and plasma per the labs.
The key is treating the underlying trigger.

situations.title: TRALI 급성 호흡부전 위기
situations.tagline: She's in acute respiratory failure right after the plasma — this is TRALI!
situations.brief: 환기 지지로 TRALI에 의한 급성 호흡부전을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop the transfusion — this is TRALI, not overload.
She needs lung-protective ventilation and high oxygen.
Report the reaction to the blood bank.

situations.title: 대량수혈 저칼슘 심정지 위기
situations.tagline: His QT is stretching and he's about to arrest — push the calcium, now!
situations.brief: 칼슘 투여와 소생술로 대량수혈 중 저칼슘 심정지에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Ionized calcium is critically low — I'm pushing calcium now.
Start compressions and call the code.
Keep giving calcium with each round of products.

situations.title: 수혈 불응 지속출혈 목표 소통
situations.tagline: We keep transfusing but he keeps bleeding — I need to talk with you about what's realistic.
situations.brief: 예후와 윤리를 고려해 수혈 불응 지속출혈의 치료 목표를 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: Despite everything, the bleeding isn't stopping.
I want to be honest with you about what we're seeing.
Let's talk about what he would want.
